doc.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022

title: Jingles, sight-reading and residuals
summary: Commercial dates like Maxwell House meant sight-reading and residual checks.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Studio work and jingles: New York session life

blocks.x: And one call could — if you get a Coca Cola commercial, I remember one of our successful ones was Maxwell House coffee. They made it into fifty different spots, then you get paid for each spot and if it runs longer than 13 weeks you would get a nice residual check. But you rarely knew what you were going to have to play so you just had to sight read everything. And if it was professionally done you just went in and read the music and thank you, Ma’am. You know. Wham, bam, thank you Ma’am.
